_readme: OpenAI Codex CLI adapter for claude-memes. Copy this file to ~/.codex/hooks.json (or merge into an existing one), with the claude-memes binary on PATH. Codex's hook payload schema deliberately mirrors Claude Code's, so the same binary works; PostToolUse routes through the same detection as Claude Code's Bash hook, everything else is observe-only until real payload shapes accumulate (`claude-memes shapes`). Requires trusting the hooks via /hooks inside Codex. Status: experimental.
